description: Manage connected Google accounts. action='list' shows all connected accounts (no secrets). action='add' starts an OAuth flow for a new account identified by account_id (alias). action='remove' deletes local tokens for an account. action='set_default' picks which account is used when tool calls omit the `account` parameter.

account_id.description: Account alias. Required for add/remove/set_default. Must match /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$/ and not be reserved (e.g. 'default', 'all', '*'). Pass JSON null with set_default to clear the current default.

name: manage_accounts
